channel.title: IngestThis
channel.description: Articles, tutorials, and resources for Data Engineers, Scientists, Analysts, and Architects.

item.title: Data Quality Tooling Compared: Great Expectations, Soda, dbt Tests, and Anomaly Detection
item.description: A comparison of Great Expectations, Soda, dbt tests, and anomaly detection, and a layered design that uses each where it fits.

item.title: The Data Team of the Agentic Era: Generalists Owning End-to-End Workflows
item.description: The case for generalists owning end-to-end data workflows with agents, the counterargument, and how to make the transition work.

item.title: dbt on Iceberg: Incremental Models on Open Tables
item.description: How dbt incremental materializations map to Iceberg operations, and the configuration, predicates, and maintenance that keep them healthy.

item.title: Disaster Recovery for Iceberg Tables: Replication, Backup, and Restore
item.description: Disaster recovery for Iceberg across four tiers: snapshots, object versioning, catalog backup, and cross-region replication.

item.title: Deleting User Data From an Immutable Lakehouse: GDPR Hard Deletes on Iceberg
item.description: How to turn a logical delete on immutable Iceberg into a physical erasure across snapshots, versions, replicas, and downstream copies.

item.title: Geospatial Data in Apache Iceberg: Geometry, Geography, and GeoParquet
item.description: How Iceberg v3 geometry and geography types, bounding boxes, and native Parquet types give spatial data first-class standing.

item.title: Default Column Values and Field IDs: How Iceberg Schema Evolution Works at the Spec Level
item.description: How field IDs and initial and write defaults let Iceberg change schemas on large tables without rewriting data, at the spec level.

item.title: The Iceberg Table Properties That Actually Matter
item.description: The Iceberg table properties that decide file count, pruning, write amplification, retention, and metadata growth, by workload.

item.title: Inside the Puffin File Format
item.description: The Puffin file format inside out, byte by byte, covering Theta sketches for distinct values and deletion vectors.

item.title: The Lakehouse Ingestion Tool Landscape: Fivetran, Airbyte, dlt, and CDC vs Batch
item.description: How Fivetran, Airbyte, dlt, and CDC and streaming tools land well-behaved Apache Iceberg tables, and how to choose and maintain them.

item.title: Local Iceberg Development Environments: Docker, MinIO, and In-Memory Catalogs for CI
item.description: Local Iceberg development environments: in-process catalogs, a Docker Compose stack with MinIO, and CI configurations that run either.

item.title: Metadata Platforms in 2026: DataHub, OpenMetadata, Atlan, and Catalog Convergence
item.description: How the technical catalog and the metadata platform are converging in 2026, and how to arrange the two layers for a lakehouse.

item.title: Moving Iceberg Tables Between Catalogs Without Rewriting Data
item.description: Why moving Iceberg tables between catalogs is a pointer copy, and the protocol that makes a cutover safe for one table or thousands.

item.title: Logs, Traces, and Metrics as Tables: Building an OpenTelemetry Data Lake on Iceberg
item.description: Building an OpenTelemetry data lake on Iceberg: schemas for spans, logs, and metrics, ingestion, query patterns, and retention.

item.title: Orchestration in 2026: Airflow 3 vs Dagster vs Prefect vs Event-Driven
item.description: Where Airflow 3, Dagster, Prefect, and event-driven triggering stand for lakehouse pipelines in 2026, after the Prefect acquisition of Dagster.

item.title: Postgres Meets the Lakehouse: pg_lake, pg_duckdb, and When Postgres Is Enough
item.description: What pg_lake, pg_duckdb, and pg_mooncake do at the Iceberg level, and honest thresholds for when Postgres is enough.

item.title: Schema Registries and Event Schemas: Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema on the Way Into the Lakehouse
item.description: How Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema evolve through a registry, and how that maps to the schema evolution rules of Iceberg.

item.title: Storage-Partitioned Joins and the Bucket Transform
item.description: How the spec-defined bucket transform lets engines skip the shuffle in joins, and how to set it up and keep it engaged in Spark.

item.title: Synthetic Data in the Lakehouse: Generation, Governance, and Testing
item.description: What synthetic data in a lakehouse is for, the generation methods, how to preserve fidelity, and where synthetic tables belong.

item.title: Will AI Replace Data Engineers?
item.description: What the evidence shows about whether AI replaces data engineers, which parts of the job compress, and which parts do not.
